combo_label: At the Opticians × Caves & Caving × Winnie-the-Pooh

entries.clue: Vertical drop in a cave, rigged with rope or a wire ladder
Clear dome at the front of the eye, the window that light enters by
Soluble rock in which nearly all British caves are dissolved
Lamp worn on the brow so both hands stay free for the rope
Single round lens on a ribbon, favoured by comic aristocrats
Clouding of the eye's own lens, cleared by a surgeon in a short operation
Magical, as the high place where a boy and his bear are left at the last
Name the bear goes by in the first sentence, before a grander one
Chase quarry with hounds and horn, or ransack the house for lost keys
Little one of the Wood who fell in the river and thought it swimming
Scenery of bare rock pavement, swallow holes and rivers that vanish
Caked in wet earth, as a bear made himself to pass for a small black cloud
Earthenware vessel a donkey received, Useful for Putting Things In
